1	# Harness Skills：`AGENTS.md` Patch 合同
     2	
     3	本目录是协调维护、独立采用的 harness skills 规范来源。套件变化见
     4	[`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md)，既有项目和已投入使用副本的逐 skill 维护流程见
     5	[`UPGRADING.md`](UPGRADING.md)。仓库不提供 bundle 安装或自动覆盖能力；目标项目按实际需要
     6	维护全部或部分 skills，并由 Agent 按本文**增量 patch** 根 `AGENTS.md`，使文档路由、真值
     7	所有权、实施门禁和大文件拆分规则在每轮任务中可见。
     8	
     9	## Patch 原则
    10	
    11	1. 先读取目标仓库现有的根 `AGENTS.md`、适用的嵌套 `AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`、
    12	   `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 和相关索引；现有安全、授权、代码所有权、验证命令和项目特定规则必须保留。
    13	2. 只做 section 级合并，不整篇替换，不把 demo 项目名、占位符或本仓库业务规则复制到目标仓库。
    14	3. 若目标仓库已有等价章节，更新原章节；没有时才追加下方 managed block。后续运行只更新同一
    15	   block，不能制造第二套规则。
    16	4. 只注册目标仓库 registry 中实际存在并接受维护的 skill 路径；支持 grouped、flat 或项目自定义布局，
    17	   不得为匹配本示例而移动路径。
    18	5. 若 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 或索引尚不存在，先从
    19	   `document-organization-harness/assets/demo-harness/` 复制并按目标仓库事实改造，再写入链接。
    20	6. 本 harness 不创建活跃 `taskBoard` / `.agents/tasks` 控制面，也不默认要求 SubAgent、并行派发、
    21	   worktree、训练或任何执行授权。临时顺序留在会话计划；委派必须由用户明确授权。
    22	
    23	## 合并位置
    24	
    25	| 现有 `AGENTS.md` 章节 | 合并内容 |
    26	|---|---|
    27	| Documentation / Context | 渐进式披露、真值所有权、写回规则 |
    28	| Development Workflow | Mandatory Execution Gate、Anti-Drift |
    29	| Code Organization | 模块 owner、依赖方向、800/1000 行门禁 |
    30	| Skills | 仅注册目标仓库实际维护的 harness skills 及其真实路径 |
    31	| Delegation / Worktrees | 明确“用户授权后才允许” |
    32	| Testing | 保留项目原命令，补充从聚焦到广泛的验证顺序 |
    33	
    34	## 无等价章节时追加的 Managed Block
    35	
    36	把下方内容追加到根 `AGENTS.md`，并把不适用于目标仓库的条件项删掉。示例使用 grouped
    37	`.agents/skills/harness/<skill>` 路径；落地前必须按目标 registry 改成实际 grouped、flat 或自定义
    38	路径，并删除不存在的 skill 条目。不得保留占位符或无效路径。
    39	
    40	```md
    41	<!-- HARNESS-GOVERNANCE:START -->
    42	## Harness 文档与实施门禁
    43	
    44	### 上下文与渐进式披露
    45	
    46	- 项目上下文入口：[`docs/OVERVIEW.md`](docs/OVERVIEW.md)。
    47	- 按 `AGENTS.md -> docs/OVERVIEW.md -> feature/reference/collaboration/archive INDEX -> 1-3 个任务相关 leaf` 逐层读取；禁止全量读取 `docs/`。
    48	- 新 idea 统一从 `.agents/skills/harness/add-idea` 进入：边界不清时逐题 Grill，确认后由 Agent 选择新建 Feature 或 patch 现有 Feature，并按需生成 requirements、Spec 与 ADR。
    49	- `requirements.md` 持有 expected behavior 与 acceptance；active frozen Spec 持有 bounded implementation contract；accepted ADR 持有 durable architecture rationale；当前代码持有 implemented behavior；不可变 artifact、ledger 和 gate report 持有 evidence。
    50	- owning README/GOAL 持有 current state、completed、pending、blockers 和 next validation gate；会话计划只持有本轮临时顺序。
    51	- 外部 proposal 只提供 provenance/recommendation，先完成内部采纳与合同转译，不能直接作为实现合同或授权。
    52	
    53	### Mandatory Execution Gate
    54	
    55	非 trivial 实施前按顺序完成：
    56	
    57	1. 未成形 idea 先进入 `add-idea`；随后定位 owning module、requirements、active Spec、accepted ADR、README/GOAL、稳定 reference 和当前代码入口。
    58	2. contract-affecting implementation 必须引用 frozen Spec；冻结安全与授权边界、schema、公共接口、依赖方向、可变状态 owner、文件预算、测试归属和 validation matrix。
    59	3. 把 durable completed/pending/blockers/next gate 写回唯一 owning README/GOAL；临时执行顺序只放会话计划。
    60	4. 确认当前动作直接推进 active goal，且没有从开发状态、代码存在或实验结果推导出额外执行授权。
    61	5. 在声明边界内实施，保留无关修改；先跑聚焦验证，再跑影响范围支持的广泛检查。
    62	6. 验证通过后同步 owning docs、索引、changelog 和声明的 append-only evidence；没有实质影响时不要制造形式化文档改动。
    63	
    64	禁止把 `taskBoard`、`.agents/tasks` 或其他平行进度文件作为活跃控制面。禁止在用户未明确要求时委派 SubAgent 或强制并行开发。
    65	
    66	### Code Organization Gate
    67	
    68	- CLI、adapter、strategy、model 和 runner 保持薄入口；domain、state、I/O、reporting 和 orchestration 各有明确 owner。
    69	- 新增或本轮修改的手写代码文件不得超过 1000 物理行；达到 800 行时必须进行职责拆分评审。
    70	- 按稳定责任与公共接口拆分，不创建 numbered `part` 文件，也不建立无边界 `utils/common/helpers`。
    71	- 触发拆分时使用 `.agents/skills/harness/refactor-large-modules`，先冻结公共契约和行为基线，再按叶子优先迁移并验证等价性。
    72	
    73	### Repo-local Harness Skills
    74

1	---
     2	name: add-idea
     3	description: >-
     4	  Unified, docs-only entry for adding a product or engineering idea to a
     5	  harness-managed repository. Use when the user invokes add-idea or asks to
     6	  turn an idea into a new Feature or a bounded change to an existing Feature.
     7	  Inspect current owners first, Grill unclear ideas one decision at a time,
     8	  then create or patch requirements, a Spec, and conditional ADRs without
     9	  implementing code or publishing external issues.
    10	disable-model-invocation: true
    11	---
    12	
    13	# Add Idea
    14	
    15	Use this as the single explicit intake for an idea. The outcome is a clear,
    16	routed internal contract, not code implementation.
    17	
    18	Read [references/routing-contract.md](references/routing-contract.md) completely
    19	before deciding the route. When writing durable artifacts, also read
    20	`../progressive-disclosure-docs/references/feature-spec-decision-contract.md`.
    21	
    22	## Invariants
    23	
    24	- Keep the original user outcome visible while refining details.
    25	- Investigate repository facts; ask the user only for decisions.
    26	- Ask one question at a time during Grill and include a recommended answer with
    27	  a short rationale.
    28	- Do not write Feature, requirements, Spec, or ADR docs until the user confirms
    29	  the final shared-understanding summary.
    30	- The agent chooses the owner route from evidence. Ask the user only when two or
    31	  more owners remain equally valid or the choice changes a product boundary.
    32	- This skill never grants code implementation, deployment, training, execution,
    33	  external publication, or issue-tracker actions.
    34	- Do not persist interview transcripts or a separate idea backlog. Confirmed
    35	  content must return to the existing Feature/requirements/Spec/ADR owners.
    36	
    37	## Workflow
    38	
    39	### 1. Discover the current ownership map
    40	
    41	Read progressively:
    42	
    43	1. root `AGENTS.md` or equivalent;
    44	2. `docs/OVERVIEW.md`;
    45	3. `docs/feature/INDEX.md`;
    46	4. at most the likely owning Feature README/INDEX and `requirements.md` files;
    47	5. targeted reference docs and code only when they can settle a fact.
    48	
    49	Record in the session:
    50	
    51	- the problem, actor, and intended outcome;
    52	- candidate Feature owners and supporting evidence;
    53	- existing expected behavior and current implementation;
    54	- safety, authorization, public-contract, and data boundaries;
    55	- facts already established and decisions still open.
    56	
    57	Do not create a new Feature merely because the user used a new phrase. Prefer an
    58	existing owner when its responsibility and lifecycle genuinely cover the idea.
    59	
    60	### 2. Apply the clarity gate
    61	
    62	An idea is ready for routing only when these are clear enough to distinguish
    63	ownership and acceptance:
    64	
    65	- problem and intended user/business outcome;
    66	- in-scope and out-of-scope behavior;
    67	- measurable acceptance or an observable completion condition;
    68	- relevant constraints, safety, authorization, and compatibility boundaries;
    69	- candidate owner and affected contracts;
    70	- unresolved decisions that would change the owner, public behavior, schema,
    71	  state ownership, migration, validation, or rollback.
    72	
    73	If route-affecting ambiguity remains, enter Grill. If all items are already
    74	clear from the request and repository, skip Grill and summarize the inferred
    75	boundary for confirmation.
    76	
    77	### 3. Grill unclear ideas
    78	
    79	Walk the unresolved decision tree in dependency order:
    80	
    81	1. Ask exactly one decision question.
    82	2. Give the recommended answer and why it best fits current evidence.
    83	3. Wait for the user's answer before advancing.
    84	4. Update the in-session decision ledger: confirmed facts, user decisions,
    85	   rejected alternatives, open questions, and affected owners.
    86	5. Look up newly discoverable facts instead of asking for them.
    87	
    88	Do not draft contracts while questions remain open. When all blocking branches
    89	are resolved, present one compact shared-understanding summary containing:
    90	
    91	- problem and outcome;
    92	- scope and non-goals;
    93	- acceptance and stop conditions;
    94	- selected owner and affected contracts;
    95	- durable decisions and remaining non-blocking unknowns;
    96	- recommended documentation route.
    97	
    98	Ask for explicit confirmation. Continue only after the user confirms the
    99	summary or corrects it.
   100	
   101	### 4. Choose two independent routes
   102	
   103	Choose one **owner route**:
   104	
   105	- `CREATE_FEATURE`: the idea needs an independent durable owner.
   106	- `PATCH_FEATURE`: exactly one existing Feature owns the behavior.
   107	- `BLOCKED_OWNER`: ownership remains ambiguous or conflicts with project
   108	  boundaries; stop and surface the competing owners.
   109	
   110	Then choose one or more **artifact routes**:
   111	
   112	- `REQUIREMENTS_PATCH`: expected behavior, acceptance, non-goals, constraints,
   113	  or stop rules change.
   114	- `NEW_SPEC`: implementation-relevant contracts change, including public API,
   115	  schema, state machine, module ownership, data flow, migration, compatibility,
   116	  security, validation, rollout, or rollback.
   117	- `ADR_CANDIDATE`: a durable architecture decision meets the decision trigger.
   118	- `STATE_ONLY`: only the Feature's durable current-state summary or routing
   119	  changes; do not invent requirements or a Spec.
   120	- `NO_DURABLE_CHANGE`: the idea is a reversible local detail with no expected
   121	  behavior, contract, decision, or durable state impact; report the owner and
   122	  stop without changing docs.
   123	
   124	`CREATE_FEATURE` and `NEW_SPEC` are not opposites. A new Feature normally starts
   125	with requirements and may also receive its first Spec. An existing Feature may
   126	receive a requirements patch, a new Spec, an ADR, or a combination.
   127	
   128	State the chosen routes and evidence before writing. Do not ask the user to pick
   129	between routes when the repository evidence is decisive.
   130	
   131	### 5. Materialize the confirmed contract
   132	
   133	Follow the shared Feature/Spec/ADR contract.
   134	
   135	For `CREATE_FEATURE`:
   136	
   137	- create the Feature from
   138	  `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/feature-template/`;
   139	- replace every placeholder with confirmed content;
   140	- after faithfully materializing the confirmed boundary, set requirements to
   141	  `CONFIRMED`, record the real confirmation date/authority when known, and
   142	  update README requirements/route status; do not leave initial `DRAFT`
   143	  scaffolding or a stale contract-freeze blocker;
   144	- register it in `docs/feature/INDEX.md` and `docs/OVERVIEW.md`;
   145	- keep Feature lifecycle separate from Spec delivery status.
   146	
   147	For `PATCH_FEATURE`:
   148	
   149	- update the existing owner in place;
   150	- set a changed requirements revision to `CONFIRMED` only when the confirmed
   151	  shared-understanding summary fully covers that revision; otherwise stop
   152	  rather than writing a partial contract;
   153	- preserve unrelated requirements and current-state content;
   154	- add a new Spec instead of overwriting a validated or superseded Spec;
   155	- update parent routes and back-links only when new artifacts are created.
   156	
   157	For artifact routes:
   158	
   159	- when `NO_DURABLE_CHANGE` applies, write no docs and explain why;
   160	- write expected behavior only to `requirements.md`;
   161	- create a Spec and lazy index from `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/spec-template.md` and `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/spec-index-template.md` when `NEW_SPEC` applies;
   162	- create an ADR and lazy index from `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/adr-template.md` and `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/decision-index-template.md` only when the ADR trigger applies;
   163	- keep ADR-worthy rationale out of README and keep implementation design out of
   164	  requirements;
   165	- update README with links and compact status only;
   166	- append the durable transition to `changelog.md`.
   167	
   168	A blocking ADR stays `proposed` until the decision authority accepts it. A Spec
   169	cannot become `frozen` while blocking decisions or contract questions remain.
   170	
   171	### 6. Stop at the documentation gate
   172	
   173	Finish with:
   174	
   175	- selected owner route and rationale;
   176	- artifact routes and files created or updated;
   177	- requirements, Spec, and decision statuses;
   178	- unresolved blockers;
   179	- next documentation or validation gate;
   180	- explicit statement that implementation remains unauthorized.
   181	
   182	Do not implement code in the same invocation. A later implementation request
   183	must enter `project-docs-workflow` and re-check the frozen contracts.
   184	
   185	## Stop conditions
   186	
   187	Stop without expanding the change when:
   188	
   189	- the user has not confirmed shared understanding;
   190	- no owner can be selected without changing a product boundary;
   191	- expected behavior conflicts with an existing frozen contract;
   192	- a blocking architecture decision is still unresolved;
   193	- the requested artifact would create a second SSOT;
   194	- the request crosses a safety, authorization, data, or external-publication
   195	  boundary that the user has not explicitly approved.

    53	- existing expected behavior and current implementation;
    54	- safety, authorization, public-contract, and data boundaries;
    55	- facts already established and decisions still open.
    56	
    57	Do not create a new Feature merely because the user used a new phrase. Prefer an
    58	existing owner when its responsibility and lifecycle genuinely cover the idea.
    59	
    60	### 2. Apply the clarity gate
    61	
    62	An idea is ready for routing only when these are clear enough to distinguish
    63	ownership and acceptance:
    64	
    65	- problem and intended user/business outcome;
    66	- in-scope and out-of-scope behavior;
    67	- measurable acceptance or an observable completion condition;
    68	- relevant constraints, safety, authorization, and compatibility boundaries;
    69	- candidate owner and affected contracts;
    70	- unresolved decisions that would change the owner, public behavior, schema,
    71	  state ownership, migration, validation, or rollback.
    72	
    73	If route-affecting ambiguity remains, enter Grill. If all items are already
    74	clear from the request and repository, skip Grill and summarize the inferred
    75	boundary for confirmation.
    76	
    77	### 3. Grill unclear ideas
    78	
    79	Walk the unresolved decision tree in dependency order:
    80	
    81	1. Ask exactly one decision question.
    82	2. Give the recommended answer and why it best fits current evidence.
    83	3. Wait for the user's answer before advancing.
    84	4. Update the in-session decision ledger: confirmed facts, user decisions,
    85	   rejected alternatives, open questions, and affected owners.
    86	5. Look up newly discoverable facts instead of asking for them.
    87	
    88	Do not draft contracts while questions remain open. When all blocking branches
    89	are resolved, present one compact shared-understanding summary containing:
    90	
    91	- problem and outcome;
    92	- scope and non-goals;
    93	- acceptance and stop conditions;
    94	- selected owner and affected contracts;
    95	- durable decisions and remaining non-blocking unknowns;
    96	- recommended documentation route.
    97	
    98	Ask for explicit confirmation. Continue only after the user confirms the
    99	summary or corrects it.
   100	
   101	### 4. Choose two independent routes
   102	
   103	Choose one **owner route**:
   104	
   105	- `CREATE_FEATURE`: the idea needs an independent durable owner.
   106	- `PATCH_FEATURE`: exactly one existing Feature owns the behavior.
   107	- `BLOCKED_OWNER`: ownership remains ambiguous or conflicts with project
   108	  boundaries; stop and surface the competing owners.
   109	
   110	Then choose one or more **artifact routes**:
   111	
   112	- `REQUIREMENTS_PATCH`: expected behavior, acceptance, non-goals, constraints,
   113	  or stop rules change.
   114	- `NEW_SPEC`: implementation-relevant contracts change, including public API,
   115	  schema, state machine, module ownership, data flow, migration, compatibility,
   116	  security, validation, rollout, or rollback.
   117	- `ADR_CANDIDATE`: a durable architecture decision meets the decision trigger.
   118	- `STATE_ONLY`: only the Feature's durable current-state summary or routing
   119	  changes; do not invent requirements or a Spec.
   120	- `NO_DURABLE_CHANGE`: the idea is a reversible local detail with no expected
   121	  behavior, contract, decision, or durable state impact; report the owner and
   122	  stop without changing docs.
   123	
   124	`CREATE_FEATURE` and `NEW_SPEC` are not opposites. A new Feature normally starts
   125	with requirements and may also receive its first Spec. An existing Feature may
   126	receive a requirements patch, a new Spec, an ADR, or a combination.
   127	
   128	State the chosen routes and evidence before writing. Do not ask the user to pick
   129	between routes when the repository evidence is decisive.
   130	
   131	### 5. Materialize the confirmed contract
   132	
   133	Follow the shared Feature/Spec/ADR contract.
   134	
   135	For `CREATE_FEATURE`:
   136	
   137	- create the Feature from
   138	  `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/feature-template/`;
   139	- replace every placeholder with confirmed content;
   140	- after faithfully materializing the confirmed boundary, set requirements to
   141	  `CONFIRMED`, record the real confirmation date/authority when known, and
   142	  update README requirements/route status; do not leave initial `DRAFT`
   143	  scaffolding or a stale contract-freeze blocker;
   144	- register it in `docs/feature/INDEX.md` and `docs/OVERVIEW.md`;
   145	- keep Feature lifecycle separate from Spec delivery status.
   146	
   147	For `PATCH_FEATURE`:
   148	
   149	- update the existing owner in place;
   150	- set a changed requirements revision to `CONFIRMED` only when the confirmed
   151	  shared-understanding summary fully covers that revision; otherwise stop
   152	  rather than writing a partial contract;
   153	- preserve unrelated requirements and current-state content;
   154	- add a new Spec instead of overwriting a validated or superseded Spec;
   155	- update parent routes and back-links only when new artifacts are created.
   156	
   157	For artifact routes:
   158	
   159	- when `NO_DURABLE_CHANGE` applies, write no docs and explain why;
   160	- write expected behavior only to `requirements.md`;
   161	- create a Spec and lazy index from `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/spec-template.md` and `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/spec-index-template.md` when `NEW_SPEC` applies;
   162	- create an ADR and lazy index from `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/adr-template.md` and `../progressive-disclosure-docs/assets/decision-index-template.md` only when the ADR trigger applies;
   163	- keep ADR-worthy rationale out of README and keep implementation design out of
   164	  requirements;
   165	- update README with links and compact status only;
   166	- append the durable transition to `changelog.md`.
   167	
   168	A blocking ADR stays `proposed` until the decision authority accepts it. A Spec
   169	cannot become `frozen` while blocking decisions or contract questions remain.
   170	
   171	### 6. Stop at the documentation gate
   172	
   173	Finish with:
   174	
   175	- selected owner route and rationale;
   176	- artifact routes and files created or updated;
   177	- requirements, Spec, and decision statuses;
   178	- unresolved blockers;
   179	- next documentation or validation gate;
   180	- explicit statement that implementation remains unauthorized.
   181	
   182	Do not implement code in the same invocation. A later implementation request
   183	must enter `project-docs-workflow` and re-check the frozen contracts.
   184	
   185	## Stop conditions
   186	
   187	Stop without expanding the change when:
   188	
   189	- the user has not confirmed shared understanding;
   190	- no owner can be selected without changing a product boundary;
   191	- expected behavior conflicts with an existing frozen contract;
   192	- a blocking architecture decision is still unresolved;
   193	- the requested artifact would create a second SSOT;
   194	- the request crosses a safety, authorization, data, or external-publication
   195	  boundary that the user has not explicitly approved.

1	# Add Idea Routing Contract
     2	
     3	Use this contract to decide whether an idea creates a Feature or extends an
     4	existing Feature. Make the decision from repository evidence after the idea is
     5	clear; do not route from keywords alone.
     6	
     7	## 1. Session-only intake schema
     8	
     9	Keep this ledger in the conversation until shared understanding is confirmed:
    10	
    11	```text
    12	Problem:
    13	Actor / beneficiary:
    14	Desired outcome:
    15	In scope:
    16	Out of scope:
    17	Acceptance / observable completion:
    18	Constraints and safety boundaries:
    19	Candidate owners:
    20	Confirmed facts:
    21	User decisions:
    22	Rejected alternatives:
    23	Open questions:
    24	Affected contracts:
    25	```
    26	
    27	This ledger is not repository SSOT and must not be saved as `idea.md`,
    28	`interview.md`, or any parallel progress/control file.
    29	
    30	## 2. Clarity classification
    31	
    32	Classify the intake as:
    33	
    34	- `CLEAR`: ownership and acceptance can be decided from the request and current
    35	  repository evidence.
    36	- `GRILL_REQUIRED`: at least one unresolved decision can change ownership,
    37	  scope, public behavior, schema/state, safety, validation, or rollback.
    38	- `BLOCKED_FACT`: a required fact should be discoverable but cannot currently be
    39	  verified. Report the missing source instead of asking the user to guess.
    40	
    41	Do not Grill optional implementation details that can remain open in a draft
    42	Spec. Grill only decisions needed to define the boundary or freeze a contract.
    43	
    44	## 3. Owner route
    45	
    46	### `PATCH_FEATURE`
    47	
    48	Choose an existing Feature when all are true:
    49	
    50	1. one current Feature already owns the affected user/business behavior;
    51	2. the idea extends or corrects that responsibility without introducing an
    52	   independent long-term outcome;
    53	3. acceptance can be expressed as an addition or revision to that Feature's
    54	   requirements;
    55	4. lifecycle, authorization, evidence, and release boundaries remain owned by
    56	   the same Feature;
    57	5. no new top-level public artifact or cross-Feature coordination owner is
    58	   required.
    59	
    60	Evidence should include the owning README/requirements route and, when relevant,
    61	current code or interface references.
    62	
    63	### `CREATE_FEATURE`
    64	
    65	Create a Feature when any strong ownership signal applies:
    66	
    67	- independent user or business outcome;
    68	- independently accepted, deprecated, or maintained lifecycle;
    69	- independent public contract, data product, persistent artifact, or external
    70	  integration boundary;
    71	- distinct safety, authorization, evidence, or rollout boundary;
    72	- cross-Feature change that needs one durable coordination owner;
    73	- its own roadmap or multiple delivery Specs;
    74	- existing owner would become a catch-all with unrelated responsibilities;
    75	- existing granularity rules already require promotion to a Feature.
    76	
    77	Do not use document count alone when the content still belongs to one owner.
    78	Document growth is supporting evidence, not a substitute for responsibility.
    79	
    80	### `BLOCKED_OWNER`
    81	
    82	Stop when:
    83	
    84	- two Features both plausibly own the behavior and the difference affects public
    85	  contracts or lifecycle;
    86	- the proposed owner contradicts existing requirements or architecture rules;
    87	- the idea is actually a project-wide policy and no system-level owner exists;
    88	- selecting an owner would silently redefine an existing Feature boundary.
    89	
    90	Present the competing owners, consequences, and recommendation as one decision
    91	question.
    92	
    93	## 4. Artifact route
    94	
    95	Owner routing and artifact routing are independent.
    96	
    97	| Change | Required artifact |
    98	|---|---|
    99	| Expected behavior, acceptance, non-goals, NFR, stop rule | `REQUIREMENTS_PATCH` |
   100	| API/schema/state/dataflow/module/migration/test/rollout contract | `NEW_SPEC` |
   101	| Durable architecture choice with real alternatives | `ADR_CANDIDATE` |
   102	| Current snapshot or route only | `STATE_ONLY` |
   103	| Reversible local detail with no durable truth change | `NO_DURABLE_CHANGE` |
   104	
   105	A single idea may produce `REQUIREMENTS_PATCH + NEW_SPEC + ADR_CANDIDATE`.
   106	
   107	### When a Spec is not required
   108	
   109	Do not force a Spec for:
   110	
   111	- wording-only requirements clarification with no implementation consequence;
   112	- current-state correction that does not change expected behavior;
   113	- trivial local implementation detail already governed by a frozen or validated Spec;
   114	- reversible local detail with no expected behavior, contract, decision, or durable state impact (`NO_DURABLE_CHANGE`);
   115	- archive or route repair with no contract change.
   116	
   117	### When a Spec is required
   118	
   119	Create a Spec when implementation must freeze any of:
   120	
   121	- public interface or schema;
   122	- data ownership, mutable state, lifecycle, or state transition;
   123	- cross-module dependency or integration behavior;
   124	- migration, compatibility, rollout, rollback, or stop behavior;
   125	- security, privacy, authorization, or evidence boundary;
   126	- module ownership, file/interface boundary, or test seam;
   127	- validation matrix and pass criteria for a non-trivial change.
   128	
   129	## 5. ADR trigger
   130	
   131	Create an ADR only when the decision is durable and all three default signals
   132	are present:
   133	
   134	1. changing it later has meaningful cost;
   135	2. a future maintainer could reasonably choose differently without the context;
   136	3. credible alternatives exist and the choice reflects a real trade-off.
   137	
   138	Public data ownership, security boundary, persistence technology, deployment
   139	topology, cross-Feature integration, or irreversible migration decisions should
   140	be treated as strong ADR candidates.
   141	
   142	Do not create an ADR for reversible local implementation details, obvious
   143	conformance to an existing contract, formatting, naming with no domain effect,
   144	or choices already owned by an accepted ADR.
   145	
   146	## 6. Decision output
   147	
   148	Before writing files, report:
   149	
   150	```text
   151	Clarity: CLEAR | GRILL_COMPLETED
   152	Owner route: CREATE_FEATURE | PATCH_FEATURE | BLOCKED_OWNER
   153	Selected owner: <path or proposed feature slug>
   154	Owner evidence: <concise evidence>
   155	Artifact routes: [REQUIREMENTS_PATCH, NEW_SPEC, ADR_CANDIDATE, STATE_ONLY, NO_DURABLE_CHANGE]
   156	Blocking decisions: <none or list>
   157	Documentation authorization: docs-only
   158	Implementation authorization: none
   159	```
   160	
   161	The user confirms the shared boundary, not a menu of arbitrary route choices.

1	---
     2	name: project-docs-workflow
     3	description: >-
     4	  项目 docs 与主线路线的薄编排器。用于用户调整或询问当前主线、路线、并行工作面、插入阶段、
     5	  当前进度和下一步，以及非 trivial 开发、bug 修复、重构、API 或跨模块修改前后，也用于询问
     6	  已实现行为、业务口径或 expected-vs-implemented gap。先从 OVERVIEW 和 owning README 获取当前
     7	  route/state，按需读取 requirements/reference，必要时升级 project-analysis，实施后把稳定路线、
     8	  状态和证据回写唯一 owner，避免生成平行控制面。
     9	---
    10	
    11	# 项目 docs 维护编排
    12	
    13	这是一个**薄编排层**。
    14	
    15	它不替代 `AGENTS.md` 的规则，也不替代 `project-analysis` 的深度分析。它负责把两者接起来。
    16	
    17	## 目标
    18	
    19	在代码实施前后，把项目文档工作流跑完整：
    20	
    21	1. 先解析项目当前 Feature、owning README route manifest、当前 focus 与认知输出层级
    22	2. 开发前找 `docs/` 里的相关文档，并从 owning GOAL/README 获取当前状态
    23	3. 按真值类型核对上下文：requirements 管 expected behavior，冻结 Spec 管 bounded implementation contract，accepted ADR 管 durable rationale，代码管 implemented behavior，artifact 管 evidence
    24	4. 识别 requirements、active Spec、accepted ADR 与 current implementation 的差异
    25	5. 实施前确认 contract-affecting work 已有 frozen Spec，并冻结模块拆分、依赖方向、公共接口、复用边界、文件行数预算和测试归属
    26	6. 已实现功能问询、非 trivial bug 或路线依赖冲突时，必要时升级到 `project-analysis`
    27	7. 实施后判断并 patch 受影响 docs
    28	8. 验证门通过后，把稳定路线、状态、决策和证据更新到 owning docs 与 append-only artifacts
    29	9. 外部团队方案先完成来源校验、逐项采纳和内部合同转译，再进入相同实施门禁
    30	
    31	## 触发原则
    32	
    33	遇到下面这些场景，应主动使用本技能：
    34	
    35	- 用户要求实现功能、修改功能、开发新模块、重构
    36	- 用户提供的是尚未形成边界的新想法时，先路由到 `add-idea`，不要在本技能中临时发明 Feature/Spec
    37	- 用户要求调整 API、数据流、调度逻辑或做跨模块代码修改
    38	- 用户要求调整主线、把 A/B 改成并行、插入/暂停/删除阶段、切换当前 Feature
    39	- 用户询问“当前路线”“进度如何”“现在做到哪”“下一步”“继续”
    40	- 用户要求修 bug，且 expected behavior 不明显，或 bug 涉及真实代码修改
    41	- 用户询问已实现功能如何工作、某字段 / 状态 / 页面口径、需求与实现差异
    42	- 用户的问题虽然是解释类，但涉及业务口径、调用链或已实现功能行为
    43	- 用户要求根据外部团队提交的 analysis / proposal / design 开始内部实施
    44	
    45	下面这些场景通常不要触发：
    46	
    47	- 纯搜索 / 调研，且不涉及业务口径、调用链、已实现功能或需求差异
    48	- 纯测试、纯文案、纯格式、小 typo
    49	- 明确单文件 trivial fix
    50	- 用户明确要求忽略 docs
    51	
    52	## 标准流程
    53	
    54	### 阶段 -1：识别 idea intake
    55	
    56	若请求仍是未成形的 idea，缺少 owner、scope、acceptance 或 route-affecting decisions，先使用
    57	`add-idea` 完成逐题 Grill、shared-understanding confirmation、Feature owner 选择和 requirements/Spec/ADR
    58	物化。本技能只消费其确认后的内部合同，不重复访谈，也不把 idea 直接推进代码实施。
    59	
    60	若用户已经提供清晰边界且 owning Feature 与 active Spec 可定位，继续本流程。
    61	
    62	### 阶段 0：解析主线路线与认知层级
    63	
    64	先从 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 解析唯一 `CURRENT DEVELOPMENT MAINLINE`，再进入 owning INDEX/README。
    65	若 README 存在 `MAINLINE-ROUTE` manifest，以它作为当前路线 overlay；稳定依赖仍由 development plan
    66	持有，child GOAL 只持有局部状态。
    67	
    68	创建、变更、验证或汇报路线时，加载并遵循
    69	[mainline-route-contract.md](../progressive-disclosure-docs/references/mainline-route-contract.md)
    70	作为共享 schema 与认知披露合同；
    71	本 Skill 继续负责端到端编排，不另建路线管理 Skill。
    72	
    73	把用户语言规范化为稳定 route mutation：
    74	
    75	- `A -> B`：顺序依赖；`A || B`：并行；`[A || B] -> J`：汇合；
    76	- insert、pause、drop、replace：插入、暂停、移除或替换；
    77	- node ID 稳定且不可复用，只供机器使用；每个节点必须另有语义化模块/里程碑名称。
    78	
    79	上述字母只用于内部规范化。向用户复述理解、汇报路线或进度时，必须把节点映射成模块/里程碑
    80	名称，不输出 `M0`、`M3C`、`A/BC` 或 raw node ID，除非用户明确要求内部标识。
    81	
    82	然后分类：
    83	
    84	- 仅本轮先做哪一项 → session plan，不改 durable docs；
    85	- 跨会话 current focus 变化 → owning README route manifest；
    86	- 节点、依赖、并行、汇合、插入、暂停或删除变化 → development plan + README + changelog；
    87	- 当前 Feature 切换 → OVERVIEW 指针 + 新旧 owner role/README + changelog。
    88	
    89	只有解释会改变依赖、合同、证据含义或授权时才询问用户；否则简短声明理解后继续。
    90	
    91	### 阶段 1：开发前扫描 owning docs
    92	
    93	先检查：
    94	
    95	- `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
    96	- `docs/feature/INDEX.md`
    97	- owning module 的 `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
    98	- owning module 的 `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`（存在且任务涉及期望行为 / bug 时）
    99	- active `docs/feature/<module>/specs/SPEC-*.md`（contract-affecting implementation 时）
   100	- blocking Feature-local ADR 与相关 system ADR（只读当前 Spec 引用的 decision）
   101	- `docs/reference/INDEX.md`
   102	- 可能相关的 `docs/reference/*.md`
   103	- `docs/reference/code-organization.md`
   104	- owning GOAL / README 的 current-state section — completed、pending、blockers、next validation gate 和 evidence
   105	- 若任务来自外部团队：`docs/collaboration/<case-id>/INDEX.md`、问题包版本和外部方案 provenance
   106	
   107	优先用 `Glob` 找文件，再用 `Read` 读取候选文档。
   108	
   109	匹配时重点看：
   110	
   111	- 模块名
   112	- 功能名
   113	- API 名称
   114	- 关键词
   115	- 最近 changelog
   116	
   117	如果找到相关文档：
   118	
   119	- 把 `AGENTS.md` 和用户明确授权视为安全与权限真值
   120	- 把 owning `requirements.md` / confirmed contract 视为 expected behavior 真值
   121	- 把 active frozen Spec 视为本次 bounded implementation contract
   122	- 把 accepted ADR 视为 durable architecture rationale；`proposed` ADR 不能授权依赖它的实现
   123	- 把当前代码视为 implemented behavior 真值
   124	- 把不可变 artifact / ledger / gate report 视为 evidence 真值
   125	- 把 owning README 视为上述事实的当前快照，不用它替代合同、代码或证据
   126	- 任何冲突都必须分类为 contract gap、implementation gap、evidence gap 或 stale summary，不得用一层静默覆盖另一层
   127	- 外部 proposal 只作为 recommendation/provenance；只有 adoption matrix 中 `ACCEPTED` 或
   128	  `MODIFIED`，且已转译为 confirmed requirements、conditional accepted ADR、frozen Spec 与
   129	  owning README current-state link 的条目才可能进入后续实施门
   130	
   131	如果没找到相关文档：
   132	
   133	- 新 idea 或 contract-affecting 功能先进入 `add-idea`；不得因缺 owner 而直接编码
   134	- 已有明确 owner 的 trivial 局部修复可直接定向分析/实施
   135	- 不要求为无合同影响的 trivial 修改强制创建 Spec
   136	
   137	### 阶段 2：判断是否需要升级到 `project-analysis`
   138	
   139	只在下面情况升级：
   140	
   141	- 涉及跨模块调用链
   142	- 需要梳理架构 / 数据流 / 时序
   143	- 现有 docs 明显过旧，且单靠读代码难以快速建立全局视图
   144	- 用户明确在问“这个模块怎么工作”“是否有性能问题”“帮我梳理链路”这类问题
   145	- 用户询问已实现功能细节、字段 / 状态 / 页面口径或调用链
   146	- 需要判断 expected behavior 与 current implementation 的差异
   147	- 涉及非 trivial bug、RCA 或可能存在历史设计偏差
   148	- 缺少 `requirements.md`，但当前任务依赖 expected behavior 判断
   149	- 拟议路线变化与稳定 dependency/gate 冲突，或无法判断能否并行、在哪里汇合
   150	
   151	如果是 trivial 修改、口径已经明确的局部变更：
   152	
   153	- 可以不升级到 `project-analysis`
   154	- 直接读相关代码和现有 docs 即可
   155	
   156	如果用户已明确给出合法的顺序、并行、插入或 focus 调整，且不改变合同/授权，不要为了路线表述
   157	升级到深度分析。需要升级时，以 `route-impact` 调用 `project-analysis`，要求只返回 Proposed Route、
   158	Dependency/Gate Impact、Owner/Docs Impact、Risks、Validation，不向用户展开实现清单。
   159	
   160	如果升级到 `project-analysis`：
   161	
   162	- 明确告诉它默认目标是写入文档，而不是停留在纯终端分析
   163	- 优先判断当前结果应走 `update-doc` 还是 `new-doc`
   164	- 若已有合适长期文档承接，优先 `update-doc`
   165	- 若没有合适长期文档承接，再 `new-doc`
   166	- 长期知识仍应优先回填 `docs/feature/<module>/` / `docs/reference/*.md` / `OVERVIEW.md`
   167	- 不要默认再造平行的长期文档体系
   168	
   169	### 阶段 3：冻结实施前代码组织
   170	
   171	若实施来源于外部方案，先确认 case `INDEX.md` 已记录 problem/proposal 版本绑定、逐项采纳决定、
   172	内部 SSOT target 和 next gate。缺少合同转译时停止实施，不得直接从 `external-proposal.md` 编码。
   173	外部来源接收、采纳矩阵和 case 状态由 `external-collaboration-workflow` Skill 负责；本 Skill 只在
   174	采纳完成后负责内部 owning docs 与代码实施闭环。
   175	
   176	非 trivial 且影响 public contract、schema、state、module ownership、migration、safety 或 validation matrix 的实施，必须引用 active frozen Spec。模块图和详细实施合同写入 Spec；owning README 只记录 active Spec 链接、compact status 与 next gate：
   177	
   178	- 模块名、单一责任和预计文件路径
   179	- 公共 type/function/protocol/artifact 边界
   180	- 允许的依赖方向与禁止的环形/反向依赖
   181	- 可变状态所有权和序列化边界
   182	- 共享逻辑的现有消费者，避免提前建立无边界 `utils.py`
   183	- 每个手写代码文件的行数预算；硬上限 1000 物理行，800 行进入拆分预警
   184	- unit/contract/property/integration 测试的归属
   185	
   186	Blocking ADR 未 accepted、requirements 未 confirmed、Spec 仍为 draft 或存在 blocking open question 时，不得进入 contract-affecting implementation。没有模块设计时，不得直接从一个新大文件开始堆叠功能。已有或预计超过
   187	1000 行的手写文件必须先按 domain responsibility 抽离，不得机械切成 part 文件。
   188	用户明确要求拆分/抽离/模块化，或目标文件达到 800 行预警、1000 行硬门禁时，必须加载
   189	`refactor-large-modules`，按其固定责任分类、不可变合同、迁移批次、兼容策略和验证矩阵执行，
   190	不得为当前任务另造一套抽离方法。
   191	
   192	### 阶段 4：实施代码变更
   193	
   194	代码实施阶段：
   195	
   196	- 当前代码决定“现在实现了什么”
   197	- owning confirmed requirements 决定“应该实现什么”
   198	- active frozen Spec 决定“本次如何实现与验证”
   199	- accepted ADR 决定“哪些持久架构取舍不得被局部实现静默改写”
   200	- 不可变 artifact 决定“验证或实验实际发生了什么”
   201	- docs 与代码冲突时，记录 expected-vs-implemented gap；不得默认用代码改写合同，也不得根据未实现文档声称功能已存在
   202	- 涉及安全、权限、数据泄漏、holdout 或 evidence boundary 的冲突必须先停止扩张性实施并暴露 blocker
   203	- CLI、strategy、model adapter 和 runner 保持薄层，domain logic 回到 owning module
   204	- 任一本轮增改的手写代码文件超过 1000 物理行时，停止功能堆叠并在同一任务拆分
   205	- 触发抽离时按 `refactor-large-modules` 叶子优先逐批迁移，每一批都运行行为等价和 import 验证
   206	
   207	### 阶段 5：实施后做 docs 影响判断
   208	
   209	代码完成后，主动判断是否有 docs 影响。
   210	
   211	重点判断这四类：
   212	
   213	1. `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`
   214	   - expected behavior、验收标准、产品口径是否变化
   215	2. `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
   216	   - current state、API inventory、active Spec/decision links 是否变化
   217	3. active Spec / ADR
   218	   - implementation contract 是否变化；是否需要 reopen/supersede Spec
   219	   - 是否产生满足 trigger 的 durable decision；是否需要新 ADR supersede 旧 ADR
   220	4. `docs/reference/interfaces.md`
   221	   - 稳定接口、入参 / 出参、外部契约是否变化
   222	5. `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md`
   223	   - 验证方式、测试命令、运行前置条件是否变化
   224	6. `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
   225	   - 是否新增模块、模块边界是否变化、入口索引是否需要更新
   226	7. `AGENTS.md` 的“历史教训”
   227	   - 这次修复是否形成了新的稳定经验，值得追加一条编号记录
   228	
   229	如果没有实质变化：
   230	
   231	- 不要为了“形式完整”而改 docs
   232	
   233	如果确认文档已过时、缺失或与实现不一致：
   234	
   235	- 非 trivial 代码、契约、运行方式变更默认同步 docs
   236	- 只有文档拆分 / 迁移 / 大规模重构，或产品口径不确定时，先询问用户确认
   237	
   238	### 阶段 6：按影响自主 patch docs
   239	
   240	非 trivial 代码、合同、运行方式或 evidence status 变更，默认在同一任务自主 patch owning docs。
   241	只有文档拆分 / 迁移 / 大规模重构，或 expected behavior 仍不确定时，才先请求用户确认。
   242	
   243	Patch 时：
   244	
   245	- 优先增量更新现有文档
   246	- 保留仍然正确的部分
   247	- 不默认整篇重写
   248	- expected behavior / acceptance 优先回填到 `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`
   249	- bounded implementation contract 优先回填 active Spec；冻结合同发生实质变化时 reopen 或创建 superseding Spec
   250	- ADR-worthy choice 按共享 decision contract 创建/更新 ADR，不把 rationale 塞进 README
   251	- current state / API inventory / active contract links 优先回填到 `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
   252	- 稳定跨 Feature 接口契约优先回填到 `docs/reference/interfaces.md`
   253	- 验证方式优先回填到 `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md`
   254	- 新模块补 `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
   255	- 新踩坑补”历史教训”并编号递增
   256	- current focus 变化只更新 owning README route manifest/current snapshot
   257	- 稳定路线拓扑变化同步更新 development plan、README manifest 与 append-only changelog
   258	- child GOAL 维护局部 STEP/文件/测试/artifact 与 `ROUTE-NODE` state；父 README 只 roll-up 同一
   259	  node 的 ID/progress/authorization，三者变化时必须同轮同步
   260	- OVERVIEW/Feature INDEX 只在当前 Feature 指针或入口变化时更新，不复制 route summary
   261	
   262	### 阶段 7：验证门通过后回写 durable state
   263	
   264	当当前 milestone 的验证门通过后：
   265	
   266	1. 更新 owning GOAL / README 的 completed、pending、blockers、next validation gate 和 evidence
   267	2. 将稳定结论更新到 `docs/feature/<module>/`：
   268	   - 新增/变更的 expected behavior / 验收口径 → `requirements.md`
   269	   - 本次模块、schema、state、migration、validation contract → active Spec
   270	   - 稳定跨 Feature API 契约 → `docs/reference/interfaces.md`
   271	   - 满足 ADR trigger 的设计决策与取舍 → owning ADR；其余可逆局部设计留在 Spec
   272	3. 将运行结果、checksum、指标或其他过程证据写入声明的 append-only artifact
   273	4. 将 milestone 级状态迁移追加到 owning `changelog.md`；不写原始终端输出或会话步骤
   274	5. 若模块无 `docs/feature/<module>/` 目录，先建目录和 README
   275	6. 同步更新 `docs/feature/INDEX.md` 的路由表
   276	7. 运行 `python3 scripts/validate_code_organization.py`，确认增改手写文件未超过 1000 行
   277	8. 若实现来自外部 proposal，在 collaboration case adoption matrix 回填 owning SSOT、完成状态和 evidence route
   278	
   279	**核心原则：临时顺序留在会话计划；durable state、稳定结论和证据由 owning docs 与 append-only artifacts 持有。**
   280	
   281	## 文档落点规则
   282	
   283	默认只维护这一套长期文档：
   284	
   285	- `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`
   286	- `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
   287	- `docs/feature/<module>/specs/`（按需；active bounded implementation contracts）
   288	- `docs/feature/<module>/decisions/`（按需；Feature-local ADRs）
   289	- `docs/feature/<module>/changelog.md`（仅 Feature / Spec / ADR / milestone / gate 级 append-only 记录）
   290	- `docs/reference/interfaces.md`
   291	- `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md`
   292	- 其他相关 `docs/reference/*.md`
   293	- `docs/collaboration/<case-id>/`（仅外部来源、版本绑定、采纳和追溯；不保存开发进度副本）
   294	- `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
   295	
   296	不要默认再造长期并行文档体系。
   297	
   298	如果 `project-analysis` 产出了时序图、数据流图、性能观察：
   299	
   300	- 优先判断是否能更新现有 `docs/feature/<module>/` / `docs/reference/*.md` / `OVERVIEW.md`
   301	- 能承接则走 `update-doc`
   302	- 没有合适承接文档时，再走 `new-doc`
   303	- 不再把 `analysis-only` 作为默认返回形态
   304	
   305	## 输出给用户时要说明的事
   306	
   307	默认使用 L0 宏观输出，固定为最多六项：
   308	
   309	- 目标
   310	- 路线
   311	- 当前 focus
   312	- blocker
   313	- next gate
   314	- authorization boundary
   315	
   316	六项都使用语义化模块/里程碑名称，不使用内部阶段编号、字母工作面或 raw node ID。不要默认
   317	输出文件、接口、测试、命令或 artifact。用户要求展开某个工作面时进入 L1；明确要求
   318	实施、审计或 blocker 证据需要时才进入 L2。详细规则由 `progressive-disclosure-docs` 的
   319	`references/mainline-route-contract.md` 持有。
   320	
   321	在实施前，如果找到了相关 docs，可以简短说明：
   322	
   323	- 找到了哪些相关文档
   324	- 会把它们当半可信上下文
   325	
   326	在实施后，如果发现 docs 可能过时，要明确指出：
   327	
   328	- 哪份文档可能过时
   329	- 为什么过时
   330	- 是否建议 patch
   331	
   332	## 执行提醒
   333	
   334	- 本技能的目标是降低 docs 与代码脱节的概率，不是为了增加文档动作。
   335	- 小改动不要强行引入 docs 流程或 Spec。
   336	- 未成形 idea 先进入 `add-idea`；本技能不重复 Grill。
   337	- 真正需要时，再升级到 `project-analysis`。

1	---
     2	name: project-docs-workflow
     3	description: >-
     4	  项目 docs 与主线路线的薄编排器。用于用户调整或询问当前主线、路线、并行工作面、插入阶段、
     5	  当前进度和下一步，以及非 trivial 开发、bug 修复、重构、API 或跨模块修改前后，也用于询问
     6	  已实现行为、业务口径或 expected-vs-implemented gap。先从 OVERVIEW 和 owning README 获取当前
     7	  route/state，按需读取 requirements/reference，必要时升级 project-analysis，实施后把稳定路线、
     8	  状态和证据回写唯一 owner，避免生成平行控制面。
     9	---
    10	
    11	# 项目 docs 维护编排
    12	
    13	这是一个**薄编排层**。
    14	
    15	它不替代 `AGENTS.md` 的规则，也不替代 `project-analysis` 的深度分析。它负责把两者接起来。
    16	
    17	## 目标
    18	
    19	在代码实施前后，把项目文档工作流跑完整：
    20	
    21	1. 先解析项目当前 Feature、owning README route manifest、当前 focus 与认知输出层级
    22	2. 开发前找 `docs/` 里的相关文档，并从 owning GOAL/README 获取当前状态
    23	3. 按真值类型核对上下文：requirements 管 expected behavior，冻结 Spec 管 bounded implementation contract，accepted ADR 管 durable rationale，代码管 implemented behavior，artifact 管 evidence
    24	4. 识别 requirements、active Spec、accepted ADR 与 current implementation 的差异
    25	5. 实施前确认 contract-affecting work 已有 frozen Spec，并冻结模块拆分、依赖方向、公共接口、复用边界、文件行数预算和测试归属
    26	6. 已实现功能问询、非 trivial bug 或路线依赖冲突时，必要时升级到 `project-analysis`
    27	7. 实施后判断并 patch 受影响 docs
    28	8. 验证门通过后，把稳定路线、状态、决策和证据更新到 owning docs 与 append-only artifacts
    29	9. 外部团队方案先完成来源校验、逐项采纳和内部合同转译，再进入相同实施门禁
    30	
    31	## 触发原则
    32	
    33	遇到下面这些场景，应主动使用本技能：
    34	
    35	- 用户要求实现功能、修改功能、开发新模块、重构
    36	- 用户提供的是尚未形成边界的新想法时，先路由到 `add-idea`，不要在本技能中临时发明 Feature/Spec
    37	- 用户要求调整 API、数据流、调度逻辑或做跨模块代码修改
    38	- 用户要求调整主线、把 A/B 改成并行、插入/暂停/删除阶段、切换当前 Feature
    39	- 用户询问“当前路线”“进度如何”“现在做到哪”“下一步”“继续”
    40	- 用户要求修 bug，且 expected behavior 不明显，或 bug 涉及真实代码修改
    41	- 用户询问已实现功能如何工作、某字段 / 状态 / 页面口径、需求与实现差异
    42	- 用户的问题虽然是解释类，但涉及业务口径、调用链或已实现功能行为
    43	- 用户要求根据外部团队提交的 analysis / proposal / design 开始内部实施
    44	
    45	下面这些场景通常不要触发：
    46	
    47	- 纯搜索 / 调研，且不涉及业务口径、调用链、已实现功能或需求差异
    48	- 纯测试、纯文案、纯格式、小 typo
    49	- 明确单文件 trivial fix
    50	- 用户明确要求忽略 docs
    51	
    52	## 标准流程
    53	
    54	### 阶段 -1：识别 idea intake
    55	
    56	若请求仍是未成形的 idea，缺少 owner、scope、acceptance 或 route-affecting decisions，先使用
    57	`add-idea` 完成逐题 Grill、shared-understanding confirmation、Feature owner 选择和 requirements/Spec/ADR
    58	物化。本技能只消费其确认后的内部合同，不重复访谈，也不把 idea 直接推进代码实施。
    59	
    60	若用户已经提供清晰边界且 owning Feature 与 active Spec 可定位，继续本流程。
    61	
    62	### 阶段 0：解析主线路线与认知层级
    63	
    64	先从 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 解析唯一 `CURRENT DEVELOPMENT MAINLINE`，再进入 owning INDEX/README。
    65	若 README 存在 `MAINLINE-ROUTE` manifest，以它作为当前路线 overlay；稳定依赖仍由 development plan
    66	持有，child GOAL 只持有局部状态。
    67	
    68	创建、变更、验证或汇报路线时，加载并遵循
    69	[mainline-route-contract.md](../progressive-disclosure-docs/references/mainline-route-contract.md)
    70	作为共享 schema 与认知披露合同；
    71	本 Skill 继续负责端到端编排，不另建路线管理 Skill。
    72	
    73	把用户语言规范化为稳定 route mutation：
    74	
    75	- `A -> B`：顺序依赖；`A || B`：并行；`[A || B] -> J`：汇合；
    76	- insert、pause、drop、replace：插入、暂停、移除或替换；
    77	- node ID 稳定且不可复用，只供机器使用；每个节点必须另有语义化模块/里程碑名称。
    78	
    79	上述字母只用于内部规范化。向用户复述理解、汇报路线或进度时，必须把节点映射成模块/里程碑
    80	名称，不输出 `M0`、`M3C`、`A/BC` 或 raw node ID，除非用户明确要求内部标识。
    81	
    82	然后分类：
    83	
    84	- 仅本轮先做哪一项 → session plan，不改 durable docs；
    85	- 跨会话 current focus 变化 → owning README route manifest；
    86	- 节点、依赖、并行、汇合、插入、暂停或删除变化 → development plan + README + changelog；
    87	- 当前 Feature 切换 → OVERVIEW 指针 + 新旧 owner role/README + changelog。
    88	
    89	只有解释会改变依赖、合同、证据含义或授权时才询问用户；否则简短声明理解后继续。
    90	
    91	### 阶段 1：开发前扫描 owning docs
    92	
    93	先检查：
    94	
    95	- `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
    96	- `docs/feature/INDEX.md`
    97	- owning module 的 `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
    98	- owning module 的 `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`（存在且任务涉及期望行为 / bug 时）
    99	- active `docs/feature/<module>/specs/SPEC-*.md`（contract-affecting implementation 时）
   100	- blocking Feature-local ADR 与相关 system ADR（只读当前 Spec 引用的 decision）
   101	- `docs/reference/INDEX.md`
   102	- 可能相关的 `docs/reference/*.md`
   103	- `docs/reference/code-organization.md`
   104	- owning GOAL / README 的 current-state section — completed、pending、blockers、next validation gate 和 evidence
   105	- 若任务来自外部团队：`docs/collaboration/<case-id>/INDEX.md`、问题包版本和外部方案 provenance
   106	
   107	优先用 `Glob` 找文件，再用 `Read` 读取候选文档。
   108	
   109	匹配时重点看：
   110	
   111	- 模块名
   112	- 功能名
   113	- API 名称
   114	- 关键词
   115	- 最近 changelog
   116	
   117	如果找到相关文档：
   118	
   119	- 把 `AGENTS.md` 和用户明确授权视为安全与权限真值
   120	- 把 owning `requirements.md` / confirmed contract 视为 expected behavior 真值
   121	- 把 active frozen Spec 视为本次 bounded implementation contract
   122	- 把 accepted ADR 视为 durable architecture rationale；`proposed` ADR 不能授权依赖它的实现
   123	- 把当前代码视为 implemented behavior 真值
   124	- 把不可变 artifact / ledger / gate report 视为 evidence 真值
   125	- 把 owning README 视为上述事实的当前快照，不用它替代合同、代码或证据
   126	- 任何冲突都必须分类为 contract gap、implementation gap、evidence gap 或 stale summary，不得用一层静默覆盖另一层
   127	- 外部 proposal 只作为 recommendation/provenance；只有 adoption matrix 中 `ACCEPTED` 或
   128	  `MODIFIED`，且已转译为 confirmed requirements、conditional accepted ADR、frozen Spec 与
   129	  owning README current-state link 的条目才可能进入后续实施门
   130	
   131	如果没找到相关文档：
   132	
   133	- 新 idea 或 contract-affecting 功能先进入 `add-idea`；不得因缺 owner 而直接编码
   134	- 已有明确 owner 的 trivial 局部修复可直接定向分析/实施
   135	- 不要求为无合同影响的 trivial 修改强制创建 Spec
   136	
   137	### 阶段 2：判断是否需要升级到 `project-analysis`
   138	
   139	只在下面情况升级：
   140	
   141	- 涉及跨模块调用链
   142	- 需要梳理架构 / 数据流 / 时序
   143	- 现有 docs 明显过旧，且单靠读代码难以快速建立全局视图
   144	- 用户明确在问“这个模块怎么工作”“是否有性能问题”“帮我梳理链路”这类问题
   145	- 用户询问已实现功能细节、字段 / 状态 / 页面口径或调用链
   146	- 需要判断 expected behavior 与 current implementation 的差异
   147	- 涉及非 trivial bug、RCA 或可能存在历史设计偏差
   148	- 缺少 `requirements.md`，但当前任务依赖 expected behavior 判断
   149	- 拟议路线变化与稳定 dependency/gate 冲突，或无法判断能否并行、在哪里汇合
   150	
   151	如果是 trivial 修改、口径已经明确的局部变更：
   152	
   153	- 可以不升级到 `project-analysis`
   154	- 直接读相关代码和现有 docs 即可
   155	
   156	如果用户已明确给出合法的顺序、并行、插入或 focus 调整，且不改变合同/授权，不要为了路线表述
   157	升级到深度分析。需要升级时，以 `route-impact` 调用 `project-analysis`，要求只返回 Proposed Route、
   158	Dependency/Gate Impact、Owner/Docs Impact、Risks、Validation，不向用户展开实现清单。
   159	
   160	如果升级到 `project-analysis`：
   161	
   162	- 明确告诉它默认目标是写入文档，而不是停留在纯终端分析
   163	- 优先判断当前结果应走 `update-doc` 还是 `new-doc`
   164	- 若已有合适长期文档承接，优先 `update-doc`
   165	- 若没有合适长期文档承接，再 `new-doc`
   166	- 长期知识仍应优先回填 `docs/feature/<module>/` / `docs/reference/*.md` / `OVERVIEW.md`
   167	- 不要默认再造平行的长期文档体系
   168	
   169	### 阶段 3：冻结实施前代码组织
   170	
   171	若实施来源于外部方案，先确认 case `INDEX.md` 已记录 problem/proposal 版本绑定、逐项采纳决定、
   172	内部 SSOT target 和 next gate。缺少合同转译时停止实施，不得直接从 `external-proposal.md` 编码。
   173	外部来源接收、采纳矩阵和 case 状态由 `external-collaboration-workflow` Skill 负责；本 Skill 只在
   174	采纳完成后负责内部 owning docs 与代码实施闭环。
   175	
   176	非 trivial 且影响 public contract、schema、state、module ownership、migration、safety 或 validation matrix 的实施，必须引用 active frozen Spec。模块图和详细实施合同写入 Spec；owning README 只记录 active Spec 链接、compact status 与 next gate：
   177	
   178	- 模块名、单一责任和预计文件路径
   179	- 公共 type/function/protocol/artifact 边界
   180	- 允许的依赖方向与禁止的环形/反向依赖
   181	- 可变状态所有权和序列化边界
   182	- 共享逻辑的现有消费者，避免提前建立无边界 `utils.py`
   183	- 每个手写代码文件的行数预算；硬上限 1000 物理行，800 行进入拆分预警
   184	- unit/contract/property/integration 测试的归属
   185	
   186	Blocking ADR 未 accepted、requirements 未 confirmed、Spec 仍为 draft 或存在 blocking open question 时，不得进入 contract-affecting implementation。没有模块设计时，不得直接从一个新大文件开始堆叠功能。已有或预计超过
   187	1000 行的手写文件必须先按 domain responsibility 抽离，不得机械切成 part 文件。
   188	用户明确要求拆分/抽离/模块化，或目标文件达到 800 行预警、1000 行硬门禁时，必须加载
   189	`refactor-large-modules`，按其固定责任分类、不可变合同、迁移批次、兼容策略和验证矩阵执行，
   190	不得为当前任务另造一套抽离方法。
   191	
   192	### 阶段 4：实施代码变更
   193	
   194	代码实施阶段：
   195	
   196	- 当前代码决定“现在实现了什么”
   197	- owning confirmed requirements 决定“应该实现什么”
   198	- active frozen Spec 决定“本次如何实现与验证”
   199	- accepted ADR 决定“哪些持久架构取舍不得被局部实现静默改写”
   200	- 不可变 artifact 决定“验证或实验实际发生了什么”
   201	- docs 与代码冲突时，记录 expected-vs-implemented gap；不得默认用代码改写合同，也不得根据未实现文档声称功能已存在
   202	- 涉及安全、权限、数据泄漏、holdout 或 evidence boundary 的冲突必须先停止扩张性实施并暴露 blocker
   203	- CLI、strategy、model adapter 和 runner 保持薄层，domain logic 回到 owning module
   204	- 任一本轮增改的手写代码文件超过 1000 物理行时，停止功能堆叠并在同一任务拆分
   205	- 触发抽离时按 `refactor-large-modules` 叶子优先逐批迁移，每一批都运行行为等价和 import 验证
   206	
   207	### 阶段 5：实施后做 docs 影响判断
   208	
   209	代码完成后，主动判断是否有 docs 影响。
   210	
   211	重点判断这四类：
   212	
   213	1. `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`
   214	   - expected behavior、验收标准、产品口径是否变化
   215	2. `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
   216	   - current state、API inventory、active Spec/decision links 是否变化
   217	3. active Spec / ADR
   218	   - implementation contract 是否变化；是否需要 reopen/supersede Spec
   219	   - 是否产生满足 trigger 的 durable decision；是否需要新 ADR supersede 旧 ADR
   220	4. `docs/reference/interfaces.md`
   221	   - 稳定接口、入参 / 出参、外部契约是否变化
   222	5. `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md`
   223	   - 验证方式、测试命令、运行前置条件是否变化
   224	6. `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
   225	   - 是否新增模块、模块边界是否变化、入口索引是否需要更新
   226	7. `AGENTS.md` 的“历史教训”
   227	   - 这次修复是否形成了新的稳定经验，值得追加一条编号记录
   228	
   229	如果没有实质变化：
   230	
   231	- 不要为了“形式完整”而改 docs
   232	
   233	如果确认文档已过时、缺失或与实现不一致：
   234	
   235	- 非 trivial 代码、契约、运行方式变更默认同步 docs
   236	- 只有文档拆分 / 迁移 / 大规模重构，或产品口径不确定时，先询问用户确认
   237	
   238	### 阶段 6：按影响自主 patch docs
   239	
   240	非 trivial 代码、合同、运行方式或 evidence status 变更，默认在同一任务自主 patch owning docs。
   241	只有文档拆分 / 迁移 / 大规模重构，或 expected behavior 仍不确定时，才先请求用户确认。
   242	
   243	Patch 时：
   244	
   245	- 优先增量更新现有文档
   246	- 保留仍然正确的部分
   247	- 不默认整篇重写
   248	- expected behavior / acceptance 优先回填到 `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`
   249	- bounded implementation contract 优先回填 active Spec；冻结合同发生实质变化时 reopen 或创建 superseding Spec
   250	- ADR-worthy choice 按共享 decision contract 创建/更新 ADR，不把 rationale 塞进 README
   251	- current state / API inventory / active contract links 优先回填到 `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
   252	- 稳定跨 Feature 接口契约优先回填到 `docs/reference/interfaces.md`
   253	- 验证方式优先回填到 `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md`
   254	- 新模块补 `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
   255	- 新踩坑补”历史教训”并编号递增
   256	- current focus 变化只更新 owning README route manifest/current snapshot
   257	- 稳定路线拓扑变化同步更新 development plan、README manifest 与 append-only changelog
   258	- child GOAL 维护局部 STEP/文件/测试/artifact 与 `ROUTE-NODE` state；父 README 只 roll-up 同一
   259	  node 的 ID/progress/authorization，三者变化时必须同轮同步
   260	- OVERVIEW/Feature INDEX 只在当前 Feature 指针或入口变化时更新，不复制 route summary
   261	
   262	### 阶段 7：验证门通过后回写 durable state
   263	
   264	当当前 milestone 的验证门通过后：
   265	
   266	1. 更新 owning GOAL / README 的 completed、pending、blockers、next validation gate 和 evidence
   267	2. 将稳定结论更新到 `docs/feature/<module>/`：
   268	   - 新增/变更的 expected behavior / 验收口径 → `requirements.md`
   269	   - 本次模块、schema、state、migration、validation contract → active Spec
   270	   - 稳定跨 Feature API 契约 → `docs/reference/interfaces.md`
   271	   - 满足 ADR trigger 的设计决策与取舍 → owning ADR；其余可逆局部设计留在 Spec
   272	3. 将运行结果、checksum、指标或其他过程证据写入声明的 append-only artifact
   273	4. 将 milestone 级状态迁移追加到 owning `changelog.md`；不写原始终端输出或会话步骤
   274	5. 若模块无 `docs/feature/<module>/` 目录，先建目录和 README
   275	6. 同步更新 `docs/feature/INDEX.md` 的路由表
   276	7. 运行 `python3 scripts/validate_code_organization.py`，确认增改手写文件未超过 1000 行
   277	8. 若实现来自外部 proposal，在 collaboration case adoption matrix 回填 owning SSOT、完成状态和 evidence route
   278	
   279	**核心原则：临时顺序留在会话计划；durable state、稳定结论和证据由 owning docs 与 append-only artifacts 持有。**
   280	
   281	## 文档落点规则
   282	
   283	默认只维护这一套长期文档：
   284	
   285	- `docs/feature/<module>/requirements.md`
   286	- `docs/feature/<module>/README.md` / `INDEX.md`
   287	- `docs/feature/<module>/specs/`（按需；active bounded implementation contracts）
   288	- `docs/feature/<module>/decisions/`（按需；Feature-local ADRs）
   289	- `docs/feature/<module>/changelog.md`（仅 Feature / Spec / ADR / milestone / gate 级 append-only 记录）
   290	- `docs/reference/interfaces.md`
   291	- `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md`
   292	- 其他相关 `docs/reference/*.md`
   293	- `docs/collaboration/<case-id>/`（仅外部来源、版本绑定、采纳和追溯；不保存开发进度副本）
   294	- `docs/OVERVIEW.md`
   295	
   296	不要默认再造长期并行文档体系。
   297	
   298	如果 `project-analysis` 产出了时序图、数据流图、性能观察：
   299	
   300	- 优先判断是否能更新现有 `docs/feature/<module>/` / `docs/reference/*.md` / `OVERVIEW.md`
   301	- 能承接则走 `update-doc`
   302	- 没有合适承接文档时，再走 `new-doc`
   303	- 不再把 `analysis-only` 作为默认返回形态
   304	
   305	## 输出给用户时要说明的事
   306	
   307	默认使用 L0 宏观输出，固定为最多六项：
   308	
   309	- 目标
   310	- 路线
   311	- 当前 focus
   312	- blocker
   313	- next gate
   314	- authorization boundary
   315	
   316	六项都使用语义化模块/里程碑名称，不使用内部阶段编号、字母工作面或 raw node ID。不要默认
   317	输出文件、接口、测试、命令或 artifact。用户要求展开某个工作面时进入 L1；明确要求
   318	实施、审计或 blocker 证据需要时才进入 L2。详细规则由 `progressive-disclosure-docs` 的
   319	`references/mainline-route-contract.md` 持有。
   320	
   321	在实施前，如果找到了相关 docs，可以简短说明：
   322	
   323	- 找到了哪些相关文档
   324	- 会把它们当半可信上下文
   325	
   326	在实施后，如果发现 docs 可能过时，要明确指出：
   327	
   328	- 哪份文档可能过时
   329	- 为什么过时
   330	- 是否建议 patch
   331	
   332	## 执行提醒
   333	
   334	- 本技能的目标是降低 docs 与代码脱节的概率，不是为了增加文档动作。
   335	- 小改动不要强行引入 docs 流程或 Spec。
   336	- 未成形 idea 先进入 `add-idea`；本技能不重复 Grill。
   337	- 真正需要时，再升级到 `project-analysis`。

1	---
     2	name: external-collaboration-workflow
     3	description: 管理本仓库与外部团队之间的问题分析和方案交付闭环。用户要求整理问题或证据包交给外部团队、接收/录入/评审外部 analysis 或 proposal、逐项采纳外部建议、把方案转译成内部 confirmed requirements、conditional ADR、frozen Spec 与 current-state route、根据已采纳方案实施开发、追踪外部建议到验证证据、或关闭外部合作 case 时使用。禁止把外部方案直接当作内部合同、当前实现或授权。
     4	---
     5	
     6	# 外部团队协作闭环
     7	
     8	统一管理 `问题包 -> 外部方案 -> 内部采纳 -> 合同转译 -> 实施验证 -> 关闭`，保留来源可追溯性，
     9	同时避免外部文档成为第二套项目 SSOT 或进度系统。
    10	
    11	## 首先确定操作阶段
    12	
    13	| 用户意图 | 阶段 | 主要输出 |
    14	|---|---|---|
    15	| 整理问题交给外部团队 | problem intake | 新 case 和 `problem-statement.md` |
    16	| 收到外部分析/方案 | proposal receipt | 忠实的 `external-proposal.md` 与 provenance |
    17	| 评审或讨论外部方案 | internal review | case `INDEX.md` adoption matrix |
    18	| 按方案开发 | contract translation / implementation | 内部 SSOT 变更后才实施代码 |
    19	| 核对方案是否落地 | validation/traceability | SSOT、代码、测试和 evidence 映射 |
    20	| 合作完成/终止 | closure | closed case 和最终证据路由 |
    21

    26	1. 读取仓库根 `AGENTS.md` 和 `docs/OVERVIEW.md`。
    27	2. 若仓库存在 `docs/reference/external-collaboration-workflow.md`，完整读取它；若不存在，
    28	   将项目特定协作 policy 标记为 docs gap，并以本 Skill 的来源、采纳和转译门禁作为最低合同。
    29	3. 进入 `docs/collaboration/INDEX.md`，只读目标 case 的 `INDEX.md` 和本阶段所需的一份来源文件。

    31	   development plan/design 和 `docs/reference/code-organization.md`。
    32	
    33	外部来源文件是 `source_record`：只提供 provenance/recommendation，不提供实施授权。
    34	
    35	## 1. 创建问题 Case
    36	
    37	使用确定性脚本，不手工发明目录和字段。先从当前 skill registry 或已加载 skill 元数据解析
    38	`external-collaboration-workflow` 的实际根目录；不得假设 grouped、flat 或 custom 布局：

    41	EXTERNAL_COLLAB_SKILL_ROOT=/absolute/path/from-the-current-skill-registry
    42	python3 "$EXTERNAL_COLLAB_SKILL_ROOT/scripts/create_case.py" \
    43	  --case-id EC-YYYY-NNN-short-slug \

    52	- 复现命令、artifact/checksum、时间窗、输入版本和脱敏声明；
    53	- 范围内/外、安全、授权、数据、兼容和不可变边界；

    75

    78	- `REJECTED`：不进入内部合同，并记录理由；
    79	- `DEFERRED`：明确延期条件和未来 gate；

    85	
    86	## 4. 合同转译和实施
    87	
    88	实施前同时使用 `project-docs-workflow`，逐条完成：
    89	
    90	1. expected behavior、acceptance、stop rules -> owning confirmed `requirements.md`；
    91	2. 满足 durable decision trigger 的架构取舍 -> owning accepted ADR；
    92	3. 接口、schema、数据流、状态、模块图、依赖、复用、文件预算、测试和 validation matrix -> frozen Spec；
    93	4. stable cross-Feature reference -> owning `docs/reference/*`；
    94	5. current pending/blockers/active contracts/next gate -> owning README；
    95	6. 采纳与合同迁移 -> append-only `changelog.md`。
    96	
    97	只有内部转译完成、blocking ADR accepted、Spec frozen、case 达到
    98	`READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION`，且用户/项目合同另行授权实施后，才能改代码。大型模块或
    99	800/1000 行门禁同时使用 `refactor-large-modules`。

   101	实施从 owning Feature 文档进入，不从 `external-proposal.md` 进入。外部建议中的伪代码、文件名、
   102	阈值和测试建议仍需按当前代码和内部合同复核。

   105

   107	
   108	- current snapshot -> owning README/GOAL；
   109	- expected behavior -> requirements；
   110	- milestone/gate history -> changelog；

   115	item 已决定、采纳项已转译、实施项已完成/延期/拒绝且证据可达后，才能关闭 case，并把它从
   116	Active Cases 移入 Closed Cases。
   117	
   118	## 停止条件
   119	
   120	遇到以下情况停止扩张性动作并报告：
   121	
   122	- 外部方案无法绑定明确的问题包版本；
   123	- 原始来源、external owner 或内容 fingerprint 不可确认；
   124	- 建议仍是 `PENDING`，或虽采纳但尚未转译到内部 SSOT；
   125	- 建议跨越项目安全、授权、数据、holdout、core 或证据边界；
   126	- 用户只要求整理/评审方案，却尚未授权代码实施；
   127	- 外部方案与当前代码不符，且无法分类 contract/implementation/evidence/stale-summary gap。

   130	
   131	最终说明当前 case 状态、problem/proposal 版本、采纳/拒绝/延期条目、内部 SSOT 目标、实际验证
   132	和 evidence、剩余 blocker 与 next gate。不得仅回复“已按外部方案实现”。

1	---
     2	name: progressive-disclosure-docs
     3	description: >-
     4	  Design, audit, or refactor project documentation so AI agents navigate by
     5	  progressive disclosure: AGENTS.md/OVERVIEW.md as maps, feature/reference/archive
     6	  indexes as routing layers, owning module documents loaded only on demand, and
     7	  mutable mainline routes reported from macro status to implementation detail.
     8	  Use when creating or refactoring project docs for AI coding agents, auditing
     9	  docs compatibility with context engineering, adding AGENTS.md or docs indexes,
    10	  or migrating scattered Markdown into a navigable docs-first structure.
    11	---
    12	
    13	# Progressive Disclosure Docs Harness
    14	
    15	Keep AI agents from loading an entire repository's documentation at once. Instead, expose a small stable map first, then route the agent into only the 1-3 documents relevant to the current task.
    16	
    17	```text
    18	Do not make agents read the city.
    19	Give them a map, then signs, then the room they actually need.
    20	```
    21	
    22	## When to Use
    23	
    24	- Creating or refactoring project docs for AI coding agents.
    25	- Auditing whether a repo's docs are compatible with Harness Engineering / Context Engineering practices.
    26	- Adding `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/OVERVIEW.md`, or docs indexes.
    27	- Organizing large feature docs, current-state summaries, bugfix notes, RCA docs, API references, or historical plans.
    28	- Migrating a project from scattered Markdown files into a navigable docs-first structure.
    29	
    30	Do **not** use for general prose editing, API reference generation alone, or one-off README cleanup.
    31	
    32	## Golden Navigation Skeleton
    33	
    34	```text
    35	AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
    36	  ↓
    37	docs/OVERVIEW.md
    38	  ↓
    39	docs/feature/INDEX.md   docs/reference/INDEX.md   docs/collaboration/INDEX.md   docs/archive/INDEX.md
    40	  ↓                      ↓                         ↓                             ↓
    41	docs/feature/<module>/   stable technical facts    external source records       historical evidence
    42	  ↓
    43	INDEX.md / README.md / requirements.md
    44	  ↓
    45	specs/ / decisions/ / design.md / dataflow.md / changelog.md / RCA.md
    46	```
    47	
    48	`requirements.md` records expected product / business behavior and acceptance.
    49	`README.md` / `INDEX.md` record the durable Feature map, current implemented
    50	state, contract links, module routing, API inventory, and known gaps. Specs own
    51	bounded implementation contracts; ADRs own durable architectural rationale.
    52	Do not use a README as the only source of truth for requirements, detailed
    53	design, decisions, and current implementation.
    54	
    55	Read and apply [`references/feature-spec-decision-contract.md`](references/feature-spec-decision-contract.md) when creating or changing a Feature, Spec, or ADR.
    56	
    57	**durable docs 与会话计划的分离**：
    58	
    59	| 目录 | 职责 | 生命周期 |
    60	|------|------|------|
    61	| `docs/` | SSOT — 描述系统是什么、当前状态与稳定证据 | 长期维护 |
    62	| 会话计划 | 当前轮次的临时顺序与检查项 | 不持久化为仓库控制面 |
    63	
    64	Truth ownership must also be explicit:
    65	
    66	| Truth type | Owner |
    67	|---|---|
    68	| Safety and authorization | `AGENTS.md` plus explicit user direction |
    69	| Expected behavior and acceptance | owning `requirements.md` / frozen contract |
    70	| Bounded implementation contract | active frozen Spec |
    71	| Durable architectural rationale | accepted ADR at the owning Feature/reference route |
    72	| Current implementation | current code |
    73	| Validation and research evidence | immutable artifacts, ledgers, and gate reports |
    74	| External problem/proposal provenance | `docs/collaboration/<case-id>/` source records and adoption map |
    75	| Project current-mainline pointer | `docs/OVERVIEW.md` |
    76	| Stable route topology | owning `development-plan.md` |
    77	| Current route overlay and state summary | owning `README.md` |
    78	| Child workstream detail | owning child GOAL; parent README keeps one-node roll-up |
    79	| State-transition history | owning append-only `changelog.md` |
    80	| Current-turn sequencing | session plan only |
    81	
    82	Conflicts must be classified as contract, implementation, evidence, or stale-summary gaps. Never
    83	silently rewrite one truth type from another.
    84	
    85	Layer responsibilities:
    86	
    87	| Level | File | Job |
    88	|---|---|---|
    89	| 0 | AGENTS.md / AGENTS.md | Stable agent contract. Short enough to always load. |
    90	| 1 | docs/OVERVIEW.md | Project map and the single current-Feature pointer. |
    91	| 2F | docs/feature/INDEX.md | Feature routing table: module categories and entrypoints. |
    92	| 2R | docs/reference/INDEX.md | Stable facts: architecture, API references, contracts, runbooks. |
    93	| 2C | docs/collaboration/INDEX.md | External-collaboration source records, version binding, and adoption routing. |
    94	| 2A | docs/archive/INDEX.md | Historical material: completed plans, bugfix notes, RCA. Default: do not read. |
    95	| 3 | docs/feature/\<module\>/INDEX.md | Module-level map or summary. |
    96	| 4 | Detailed module docs | Requirements, design, data flow. Read only when task-relevant. |
    97	
    98	## Required Agent Reading Rule
    99	
   100	Include in `AGENTS.md` and `docs/OVERVIEW.md`:
   101	
   102	```text
   103	文档遵循渐进式披露（Progressive Disclosure），Agent 逐层深入、禁止全量读取：
   104	
   105	Level 0: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md     → 项目开发规约与读取入口
   106	Level 1: docs/OVERVIEW.md          → 项目是什么？有哪些模块？去哪里找？
   107	Level 2F: feature/INDEX.md         → 功能模块索引，先选目标模块
   108	Level 2R: reference/INDEX.md       → 架构 / API / 测试 / 运维等稳定参考
   109	Level 2C: collaboration/INDEX.md   → 外部问题包、方案来源和内部采纳路由
   110	Level 2A: archive/INDEX.md         → 已完成计划 / bugfix / RCA 归档，默认不读
   111	Level 3: feature/<module>/INDEX.md → 大型模块内部导航
   112	Level 4: 具体设计 / 数据流 / RCA，仅按需读取
   113	
   114	Agent 读取规则：OVERVIEW → INDEX → 按需读 1-3 个相关文档。禁止全量读取 docs。
   115	当前进度、阻塞和下一验证门由 owning GOAL/README 持久化。
   116	外部 proposal 只能作为 provenance/recommendation；先转译到内部合同，再从 owning Feature 实施。
   117	```
   118	
   119	## AGENTS.md Requirements
   120	
   121	Stay small and stable. Include:
   122	
   123	1. **Context entrypoint**: `> 项目上下文入口：[docs/OVERVIEW.md](docs/OVERVIEW.md)`
   124	2. **One-paragraph project description**: what this project is and must not become.
   125	3. **Hard architecture constraints**: layer dependencies, no-bypass rules.
   126	4. **Progressive disclosure rule**: the level table above.
   127	5. **Write rules**: when to create feature/reference/archive docs, when to update indexes.
   128	6. **Testing and update rules**: which docs/tests to update when interfaces change.
   129	
   130	## docs/OVERVIEW.md Requirements
   131	
   132	First docs file an agent reads. Must answer:
   133	- What is this system?
   134	- What are the main modules?
   135	- Which docs index should I enter next?
   136	- What should I avoid reading by default?
   137	- How do I run or validate the project?
   138	
   139	Keep it compact. If it grows into full design documentation, split details into feature/reference docs.
   140	
   141	## docs/feature/INDEX.md Requirements
   142	
   143	Classify modules by reading depth — not just list files:
   144	
   145	- **Large modules** (subdir + INDEX + multi-file): link to `module/INDEX.md`
   146	- **Medium modules** (README + sub-files): link to `module/README.md`
   147	- **Small modules** (single file): link to `module/README.md`
   148	
   149	Include agent routing: "先读本 INDEX.md 确定目标模块，再按需进入子目录。禁止全量读取。"
   150	Route expected behavior / product acceptance to `requirements.md`; route current
   151	implementation, API lists, current status, and known gaps to `README.md` /
   152	`INDEX.md`.
   153	
   154	## Module Directory Requirements
   155	
   156	Large module:
   157	
   158	```text
   159	docs/feature/<module>/
   160	├── INDEX.md       # module map, always read before details
   161	├── README.md      # current implemented state, API inventory, known gaps
   162	├── requirements.md # expected product/business behavior and acceptance
   163	├── specs/          # bounded implementation contracts; create lazily
   164	├── decisions/      # Feature-local ADRs; create lazily
   165	├── design.md       # stable design reference not owned by one delivery Spec
   166	├── dataflow.md     # data flow / sequence / diagrams
   167	├── changelog.md    # Feature/Spec/ADR transition history
   168	└── rca-*.md        # root-cause analysis when relevant
   169	```
   170	
   171	Module `INDEX.md` should route by task:
   172	- Need module map / reading order → `INDEX.md`
   173	- Need expected behavior / product requirements / acceptance → `requirements.md`
   174	- Need current implementation / API list / current state / known gaps → `README.md`
   175	- Need one bounded implementation contract → active `specs/SPEC-*.md`
   176	- Need durable architectural rationale → relevant accepted `decisions/ADR-*.md`
   177	- Need stable design shared by multiple Specs → `design.md`
   178	- Need data flow / sequence → `dataflow.md`
   179	- Need completed work / pending work / blockers / next validation gate → owning `README.md` or GOAL
   180	- Debugging a known incident → matching `rca-*.md`
   181	
   182	Medium: `README.md` + `requirements.md` when business behavior or acceptance
   183	matters + optional sub-docs. Small: single `README.md` unless requirements need
   184	their own source of truth.
   185	
   186	### Current-state schema
   187	
   188	An active feature README must make independent state axes machine-readable and human-readable. Do
   189	not concatenate role, lifecycle, milestone, implementation, model, evidence, and authorization into
   190	one free-form status string. At minimum record:
   191	
   192	- role;
   193	- Feature lifecycle;
   194	- requirements status;
   195	- active Spec and Spec status;
   196	- blocking decision status;
   197	- current milestone and milestone status;
   198	- implementation status;
   199	- evidence status;
   200	- authorization boundary;
   201	- last verified date;
   202	- next validation gate;
   203	- route version, semantic module/milestone names, human-readable route, focus nodes, parallel groups and joins;
   204	- completed work, pending work, blockers, and evidence routes.
   205	
   206	Upper-level indexes should route to the owner and may show a short role/lifecycle label, but must not
   207	copy the full state snapshot.
   208	
   209	### Mainline route and cognitive disclosure
   210	
   211	Treat a changing mainline as a DAG overlay, not a free-form task list. An active Feature README owns
   212	one machine-readable `MAINLINE-ROUTE` manifest plus one equivalent human route line. Its development
   213	plan owns stable dependencies; child GOALs own local detail; the session plan owns temporary focus.
   214	
   215	Normalize route changes as `A -> B`, `A || B`, `[A || B] -> J`, insert, pause, drop or replace. Keep
   216	node IDs stable and machine-only; every node also has a semantic module/milestone name. Default
   217	user-facing output is L0: goal, route, focus, blocker, next gate and authorization, expressed only
   218	with those semantic names. Do not expose phase codes or shorthand IDs unless requested. Expand to
   219	workstream L1 only on request; expose file/interface/test/artifact L2 only for implementation, audit
   220	or blocker evidence.
   221	
   222	Read and apply [`references/mainline-route-contract.md`](references/mainline-route-contract.md) when
   223	creating, changing, validating or reporting an active route.
   224	
   225	## Feature Granularity: One Feature, One Directory
   226	
   227	Do not bury an independent feature as scattered leaf files under a big catch-all
   228	category. A sub-topic must be **promoted to its own** `docs/feature/<feature>/`
   229	(with its own README) when it hits **any** of:
   230	
   231	- it has its own long-term goal or milestone roadmap (M0–Mn);
   232	- it has its own data contract / interface / output artifact;
   233	- it has an independent lifecycle (evolves and is accepted on its own);
   234	- it has accumulated **≥ 3 leaf docs**, or a single leaf has grown **≥ 500 lines**.
   235	
   236	"Related" or "reusable" is **not** a reason to nest it under a mega-category —
   237	mirror the code-organization rule "ownership by domain first". An overgrown
   238	category that hides several real features behind generic leaf names is an
   239	anti-pattern: agents can no longer route to the right feature from the INDEX.
   240	
   241	## Feature, Spec, and Decision Lifecycles
   242	
   243	Keep durable Feature and delivery lifecycles separate; use the shared contract
   244	for exact gates:
   245	```text
   246	Feature: PROPOSED -> ACTIVE -> MAINTENANCE -> DEPRECATED -> RETIRED
   247	                   \-> ABANDONED
   248	Spec:    DRAFT -> FROZEN -> IMPLEMENTATION_ACTIVE -> VALIDATION_ACTIVE
   249	              -> VALIDATED | REJECTED | SUPERSEDED
   250	ADR:     PROPOSED -> ACCEPTED | REJECTED; ACCEPTED -> SUPERSEDED | DEPRECATED
   251	```
   252	
   253	Evidence and authorization remain independent; lifecycle never grants
   254	implementation, deployment, publication, holdout, shadow, dry-run, or execution.
   255	Use `add-idea` for intake; after confirmation it selects a Feature owner and
   256	independently routes requirements, Spec, and conditional ADR artifacts.
   257	
   258	For a new Feature, copy `assets/feature-template/`, register it in Feature INDEX
   259	and OVERVIEW, and create `specs/` or `decisions/` only when needed. README remains
   260	a compact Feature/current-state owner; changelog preserves transitions and
   261	rejected, superseded, or abandoned outcomes.
   262	
   263	A Spec owns the implementation module map, public contracts, dependencies,
   264	state, migration, validation matrix, file budgets, reuse, and test ownership.
   265	It becomes `FROZEN` only after requirements and blocking ADRs resolve; separate
   266	implementation authorization is still required. The existing 800/1000-line
   267	and `refactor-large-modules` gates continue to apply.
   268	
   269	## Autonomous Docs Governance (hard rule)
   270	
   271	Docs are part of the deliverable, not an afterthought. The agent maintains and
   272	restructures docs **proactively**, without being told:
   273	
   274	1. **Autonomous maintenance**: after a non-trivial code / contract / runbook
   275	   change, in the same task update the owning feature README + `feature/INDEX.md`
   276	   + `OVERVIEW.md` module table + back-links, plus owning `requirements.md` when
   277	   expected behavior / acceptance changed, and affected `interfaces.md` /
   278	   `runbook-testing.md`. "Code changed, docs untouched" is not an acceptable
   279	   end state.
   280	2. **Autonomous restructuring**: when reading or writing docs, if a sub-topic
   281	   under a big category now meets the feature-granularity trigger above, the
   282	   agent must proactively propose splitting it into an independent feature
   283	   (confirm first per the project's interaction rule, then land it).
   284	3. **Split without breaking links**: when splitting / migrating, preserve
   285	   Top-Down reachability (add routes in the parent INDEX and OVERVIEW),
   286	   Bottom-Up traceability (leaf parent back-links), and **migrate old paths
   287	   instead of leaving them alongside the new ones**.
   288	
   289	## SSOT Validation Gate（硬性判定）
   290	
   291	`docs/` 存放的是 SSOT（Single Source of Truth），描述**系统是什么、应该如何运行**。执行过程文件、一次性分析、gap/diff 记录不属于 SSOT，严禁混入 `docs/`。
   292	
   293	### 判定流程
   294	
   295	对每个拟放入 `docs/feature/<module>/` 的文件，agent 必须按顺序回答以下问题。任何一个回答为"否"则该文件不属于 `docs/`：
   296	
   297	| # | 判定问题 | SSOT（放入 docs/） | 非 SSOT（改放别处） |
   298	|---|---------|-------------------|-------------------|
   299	| 1 | 文件描述的是**稳定的系统知识**（功能是什么、数据流如何、接口契约、组件关系），还是**临时的执行上下文**（本轮顺序、临时检查项）？ | 稳定知识 → SSOT | 临时顺序 → 保留在会话计划中，不落仓库文件 |
   300	| 2 | 功能实现**完成后**，这个文件是否仍然需要**长期维护**（随代码演进持续更新）？ | 是 → SSOT | 否（一次性分析/总结/批注）→ 不持久化；有历史价值时明确归档 |
   301	| 3 | 文件属于**模块功能描述**还是**运行/测试/验证方式**？ | 模块功能 → `docs/feature/<module>/` | 运行/测试方式 → `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md` |
   302	| 4 | 文件记录的是接口/字段/状态/枚举的**稳定契约**吗？ | 是 → SSOT，同步更新 `docs/reference/interfaces.md` | 否 → 属于不稳定草稿或执行上下文 |
   303	| 5 | 文件描述的是**预期行为/验收条件**、**冻结实施合同**、**架构决策理由**还是**当前实现状态**？ | requirements → `requirements.md`；实施合同 → Spec；持久决策 → ADR；当前状态 → `README.md`/`INDEX.md` | 都不是 → 非 SSOT；临时内容不落盘，有历史价值时明确归档 |
   304	
   305	### 典型非 SSOT 文件去向
   306	
   307	| 文件类型 | 典型示例 | 正确去向 |
   308	|----------|---------|---------|
   309	| Gap analysis / 差异分析 | `agent-io-gap-analysis.md`（模块A与模块B的接口差异） | 稳定差异并入 owning requirements/README；临时内容不落盘 |
   310	| 一次性总结/总结批注 | `agent-http-call-summary.md`（某次对接后的总结记录） | 关键内容并入 SSOT；仅有历史价值时明确归档 |
   311	| 测试运行方式 | `test.md` 描述如何启动服务、运行 E2E | `docs/reference/runbook-testing.md` |
   312	| 临时执行顺序 | 不含稳定结论的本轮步骤、检查项 | 会话计划；不创建仓库文件 |
   313	| 中间 review 产物 | Codex review 原始输出、一次性 lint 报告 | `docs/archive/<module>-reviews/` |
   314	| 临时设计草稿 | 未经评审的 schema 草稿 | 评审通过后按 SSOT 格式写入 doc，草稿废弃 |
   315	
   316	### 目录自检（交叉校验）
   317	
   318	每次创建或修改 `docs/feature/<module>/` 后，agent 必须对该目录执行一次自检：
   319	
   320	1. 列出目录下所有 `.md` 文件
   321	2. 对每个文件应用上述判定流程
   322	3. 如果发现非 SSOT 文件，立即移出；临时内容不持久化，有历史价值时明确归档
   323	4. 确认每个文件的 `> 上级：` 反链指向正确的父文档
   324	5. 确认 `docs/feature/INDEX.md` 的路由表已同步更新（新增、迁移或删除均需同步）
   325	6. 确认 `docs/OVERVIEW.md` 的模块表和反链无需增补
   326	
   327	> **失败模式**：某个 feature 目录下出现 gap analysis、测试运行方式、一次性总结等非 SSOT 文件 → 说明上一步的 SSOT 判定被跳过，需要立即纠正。
   328	
   329	### External collaboration exception
   330	
   331	External problem packages and proposals are durable provenance records, not system SSOT. They may
   332	live only under `docs/collaboration/<case-id>/`, never loose inside an owning Feature. Route creation,
   333	proposal receipt, adoption, translation and closure through the repo-local
   334	`external-collaboration-workflow` Skill; do not duplicate that workflow here.
   335	
   336	- `problem-statement.md` is internally owned and versioned after issuance.
   337	- `external-proposal.md` is externally owned; internal agents preserve the source and do not rewrite
   338	  it into an internal design.
   339	- `INDEX.md` records version binding and item-level `ACCEPTED` / `MODIFIED` / `REJECTED` / `DEFERRED`
   340	  decisions, then links each accepted item to an internal SSOT target and validation evidence.
   341	- No implementation starts from an external proposal. First translate accepted content into confirmed
   342	  requirements, conditional accepted ADRs, a frozen Spec, and owning README links; progress remains
   343	  in owning README/changelog/evidence.
   344	
   345	## Large Proposal Decomposition
   346	
   347	Design proposals (under `docs/feature/<module>/proposals/`) often carry three different audiences:
   348	
   349	| Audience | What they want | What hurts them |
   350	|----------|----------------|-----------------|
   351	| Reviewer / decision-maker | "Why, big direction, key decisions, risks" | Drowning in schema details and SQL DDL |
   352	| Implementer | "Full schema, DDL, pseudocode, integration points" | Hunting through high-level prose to find concrete spec |
   353	| Progress tracker | "Task matrix, stage gates, week-by-week path" | Reading the entire proposal each time |
   354	
   355	**Hard rule**: if a single proposal file grows to **≥ 500 lines**, decompose into a subfolder:
   356	
   357	```text
   358	docs/feature/<module>/proposals/<topic>/
   359	├── README.md       # 30-50 lines — entry, routing, audience map
   360	├── design.md       # 200-400 lines — why, direction, decisions, risks

     3	description: >-
     4	  Design, audit, or refactor project documentation so AI agents navigate by
     5	  progressive disclosure: AGENTS.md/OVERVIEW.md as maps, feature/reference/archive
     6	  indexes as routing layers, owning module documents loaded only on demand, and
     7	  mutable mainline routes reported from macro status to implementation detail.
     8	  Use when creating or refactoring project docs for AI coding agents, auditing
